in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Quint is derived from the Hebrew word חמצון (hachamtson), which means 'the fifth'. This name is not explicitly mentioned in the Bible, but it can be inferred from the use of the number five in various biblical contexts.

in_greek.name: πέντη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Quint is derived from the Greek word πέντη (pentē), which means 'five'. This name is not explicitly mentioned in the New Testament, but it can be found in various Greek texts and inscriptions related to the Bible.
